name: Section
usage: Groups of a settings page, parts of a detail page, groups of form fields in a drawer

props.name: level
props.description:
Heading level of the title, with the sizes of Heading: 2 for the parts of a page (xl), 3 for parts inside a
part (lg), 4 for the lowest level (body size, md). Nest Sections with increasing levels to build an outline
under the `h1` of Page; in a drawer, a dialog or a panel, whose own title is small, use 4.

props.name: description
props.description: One sentence of description below the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right of the title row.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing step between the title and the content, and between the children of the content.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A group of content inside a page or a drawer.

examples.name: Levels
examples.title: Levels
examples.description:
Nested Sections with `level` 2, 3 and 4 form the outline of a page below the title of Page; the sizes are those
of Heading. In drawers, dialogs and panels, use `level={4}`.
